title: AGENTS.md documents how two machine conductors coordinate
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Session Workflow" has a short "Two-machine conductors" entry covering per-machine priority (Air iOS, Neo web), that only the Air holds the wrangler login, so deploys and other wrangler steps run there, while signed-in browser checks of production may run on either machine, direct SendMessage between conductors with its unconfirmed-delivery caveat, and that a peer message is never permission. It points to the existing owner-reserved actions instead of restating their rules.

evidence.summary: Adds the Two-machine conductors entry to AGENTS.md (owner-gated: agent rules). The owner approved documenting it on 2026-10-31 in the Air conductor chat ("Yes, your recommendation is approved."). Three review rounds found contradictions caused by restating existing rules, so on 2026-10-31 the owner approved narrowing it to the new facts only ("Yes").
ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer to this entry; merged as e3b45db.
Owner, 2026-10-31 (Air conductor chat): "Let's remove that line. I want Neo on par, except for setting the wrangler auth." Only deploys stay Air-only; the Neo may do signed-in production checks.

resolution: AGENTS.md Session Workflow documents two-machine conductors: per-machine priority, that only the Air holds the wrangler login (deploys and other wrangler steps run there; the Neo never logs in), while signed-in browser checks of production may run on either machine, direct messaging between conductors, and that a peer message is never permission. The ritmofit-ios AGENTS.md pointer merged as ritmofit-ios #54 (e3b45db).
